symbols.name: JobNamingConventions
symbols.summary: Derives normalized, dash-separated names for code-first job definitions.

symbols.name: ResolveDisplayName(Type, string)
symbols.summary: Creates a lowercase display name from the job type and optionally prefixes it with the module name.

syntax.content: public static string ResolveDisplayName(Type jobType, string module)

parameters.description: The job type whose type name is converted to dash-separated lowercase text.
The optional module prefix, also converted to dash-separated lowercase text.

returns.description: The normalized job name, prefixed with the normalized module and a hyphen when a module is supplied.
